proposals.proposedText: Low, settled, and chest-open: she seems to root the space before she moves through it.
proposals.groundedIn: "grounded, settled posture" and "she is the contextual anchor of every scene she's in"

proposals.proposedText: Gentle comedy comes from everyone orbiting her calm while she absorbs chaos with one patient look or tiny correction.
proposals.groundedIn: "Stillness is her signature — she commands a scene by NOT moving while everyone orbits her"

proposals.proposedText: To keep everyone safe, included, and steady without making her own effort visible.
proposals.groundedIn: "the protective heart of Crystal Cove" and "over-functions for everyone, anticipating needs and absorbing weight"

proposals.proposedText: Warmly open at first glance, but emotionally restrained at depth; the closer it gets to pain, the smaller her expression becomes.
proposals.groundedIn: "She gets QUIETER and STILLER the more she's moved"

proposals.proposedText: Holds a soft, steady gaze long enough to let others arrive at themselves; looks away only for a private breath she is trying to hide.
proposals.groundedIn: "often answers a worry with a held look before a word" and "a small private breath she doesn't let anyone see"

proposals.proposedText: Small, slow, gathering gestures; when truly activated, the motion opens upward and outward.
proposals.groundedIn: "an open palm or a steadying hand on a shoulder; a slow, knowing nod; a gathering gesture" and "On the Crystal Call she lifts: upward, expansive, chest open"

proposals.proposedText: To be held by the group she usually holds, without having to prove she has earned it.
proposals.groundedIn: "the bear who holds everyone learns to be held"

proposals.proposedText: She worries that needing support might make her less of an anchor.
proposals.groundedIn: "mistaking self-sufficiency for strength"

proposals.proposedText: Unhurried, continuous, robe-weighted movement; never snatched, jittery, or rushed.
proposals.groundedIn: "Warm, measured, low, unhurried" and "Her robes and headdress move slowly with her — she never rushes"

proposals.proposedText: Never rushes, performs big emotion, preaches, or asks directly for help unless the story is deliberately cracking her protective mask.
proposals.groundedIn: "Don't rush Aida"; "Don't make her loud or theatrical"; "Don't give her the show's moral as a line"; "Don't let her ask for help easily or early"

proposals.proposedText: Creates a safe radius others can enter; she does not crowd, she gathers.
proposals.groundedIn: "She makes a space feel safe before anyone else has spoken" and lexicon verb "gather"

proposals.proposedText: That if she stops holding the weight, the safety of the cove will falter.
proposals.groundedIn: "Takes on too much responsibility for others" and "the protective anchor of Crystal Cove"

proposals.proposedText: Earned confidence and calm competence: she lets the crystal show strain before her face does.
proposals.groundedIn: "her confidence isn't performance but earned self-knowledge" and "watch the flicker before anyone hears the strain in her voice"

proposals.proposedText: After strain, she settles herself with a small breath, a softened gaze, and a quiet return to steadiness.
proposals.groundedIn: "a small private breath" and "steady warm pink when grounded"

proposals.proposedText: Receives embarrassment as a small, warm pause rather than a flinch; a soft smile, then she moves attention away from herself.
proposals.groundedIn: "comfortable with silence" and "warm, protective, maternal"

proposals.proposedText: She becomes stiller and more self-contained, taking on more before admitting cost.
proposals.groundedIn: "When she's over-functioning, the stillness goes tight and self-contained"

proposals.proposedText: She does not celebrate herself; she lets warmth radiate back into the group and shares the credit without saying so.
proposals.groundedIn: "Resolution: warm radiating light with the others naturally orbiting her"

proposals.proposedText: A steady central shape with slow, composed edges; readable as the room's anchor even before she speaks.
proposals.groundedIn: "the still warm centre everyone is leaning toward"

proposals.proposedText: Stillness is active care: charged, protective, and most intense when the feeling is deepest.
proposals.groundedIn: "Stillness is her signature" and "she gets QUIETER and STILLER the more she's moved"

proposals.proposedText: Forward, curious, and heart-led; she leans toward feelings before she knows what to do with them.
proposals.groundedIn: "The smallest bear with the widest heart" and "curious, warm, emotionally expressive"

proposals.proposedText: Comedy comes from over-reading the room: she catches every tiny feeling and can get tangled trying to honour all of them at once.
proposals.groundedIn: "can feel what everyone else is feeling, sometimes all at once" and "analysis paralysis"

proposals.proposedText: To understand what everyone is feeling and help them understand each other.
proposals.groundedIn: "builds empathy bridges so others can briefly see through each other's eyes"

proposals.proposedText: Very open and readable; thoughts and feelings cross her face quickly, often before she has chosen a response.
proposals.groundedIn: "emotionally expressive" and "names the feeling in the room before anyone else has words for it"

proposals.proposedText: Her gaze darts softly between faces, tracking shifts in feeling; when overloaded, it fixes as she tries to sort too many perspectives.
proposals.groundedIn: "sees every perspective simultaneously" and "too many points of view, no action"

proposals.proposedText: Small but eager gestures that multiply when she is thinking too hard; hands/paws search the air for connections.
proposals.groundedIn: "curious six-year-old cub" and "emotional translator"

proposals.proposedText: To trust her own feeling enough to take one step, instead of waiting to understand everyone perfectly.
proposals.groundedIn: "understanding has to lead somewhere" and "letting clarity become a step forward"

proposals.proposedText: She fears choosing one action means failing to honour another perspective.
proposals.groundedIn: "Because she can hold every perspective at once, she can drown in them"

proposals.proposedText: Quick, attentive, and stop-start: eager approach, sudden freeze, then another little step as clarity returns.
proposals.groundedIn: "curious" and "frozen, unable to choose or to act for herself"

proposals.proposedText: Never becomes coolly analytical or detached; her understanding must stay warm and relational, not clinical.
proposals.groundedIn: "widest heart" and "curious, warm, emotionally expressive"

proposals.proposedText: Naturally comes close to connect, but should pause when another character's feeling asks for room.
proposals.groundedIn: "builds empathy bridges" and "briefly see through each other's eyes"

proposals.proposedText: That she will misunderstand someone, or understand everyone and still not know how to help.
proposals.groundedIn: "Her flaw is the shadow side of her gift: understanding everyone can leave her frozen"

proposals.proposedText: Helpful explaining: she tries to translate the feeling in the room when what she really needs is to choose her own next step.
proposals.groundedIn: "the emotional translator" and "too many points of view, no action"

proposals.proposedText: She recovers by narrowing from everyone to one face, one feeling, one small action.
proposals.groundedIn: "letting clarity become a step forward"

proposals.proposedText: Her face gives her away immediately; she may rush to clarify, then soften when she feels she is still connected.
proposals.groundedIn: "emotionally expressive" and "Connection — Social Awareness"

proposals.proposedText: Pressure makes her collect more perspectives until she freezes; the turn is choosing one kind action.
proposals.groundedIn: "too many points of view, no action"

proposals.proposedText: Success looks like surprised relief, then immediate joy that others can see each other more clearly.
proposals.groundedIn: "creates empathy bridges" and "Understanding others begins with understanding yourself"

proposals.proposedText: A small, leaning-in presence with bright attentive energy; readable as the one trying to feel the whole room.
proposals.groundedIn: "The smallest bear with the widest heart"

proposals.proposedText: Her stillness is overload, not calm: a charged freeze when too many feelings arrive at once.
proposals.groundedIn: "she can drown in them" and "frozen, unable to choose"

proposals.proposedText: Chest-first and momentum-led; he arrives like he has already committed before checking the landing.
proposals.groundedIn: "Fuzzby horizontal, chest leading, legs trailing" and "he committed"

proposals.proposedText: To be admired as spectacular, capable, and completely in control.

proposals.proposedText: Openly performative; his face sells confidence a half-second before his body proves otherwise.
proposals.groundedIn: "rebrand a crash" and "claims the crash as choreography"

proposals.proposedText: Checks the audience for approval, especially Zenny; after a mishap, he looks to see if anyone bought the recovery.

proposals.proposedText: Big, declarative, and slightly overcommitted; gestures often create the problem he then pretends to have meant.

proposals.proposedText: To be liked even when he is not impressive.
proposals.groundedIn: "bravado is not courage yet" and "need to be adored"

proposals.proposedText: He fears being ordinary, unnoticed, or laughed at in a way he cannot convert into applause.

proposals.proposedText: Never plays random clowning; every crash or boast must reveal committed bravado or his hunger for approval.

proposals.proposedText: Bursts into others' space as if inviting them into the show; needs Zenny or another witness for the joke to complete.

proposals.proposedText: That the room will see the wobble before he can rename it as style.

proposals.proposedText: Bravado: he turns mistakes into intentional stunts before anyone can call them mistakes.

proposals.proposedText: Instant verbal spin, physical reset still catching up; he buttons the mishap before balance has returned.

proposals.proposedText: He denies embarrassment by upgrading it into a feature of the performance.

proposals.proposedText: Pressure makes him perform harder, folding danger into the act until a real feeling punctures the routine.

proposals.proposedText: He receives success as proof of legend status and immediately risks doing one more flourish.

proposals.proposedText: A travel-line silhouette: pitched into motion, limbs trailing the decision he already made.

proposals.proposedText: Stillness is rare and comic because it usually means the act has finally outrun him; use it as the stunned beat before the spin.

proposals.proposedText: Weighted toward service: he carries himself like someone already looking for what needs doing.

proposals.proposedText: Comedy comes from over-helping: he tries to be useful before anyone has actually asked, then has to manage the extra tangle he created.

proposals.proposedText: Comedy comes from borrowed confidence: he overstates competence exactly when his body reveals the gulp underneath.

proposals.proposedText: To prove he is ready to go, brave enough to leave, and worthy of the trust being handed to him.

proposals.proposedText: Tries for a brave face; the eyes and timing betray the cost before he covers it with a grin or line.

proposals.proposedText: To keep the room honest without making a big show of caring.
proposals.groundedIn: "silent puncture" and "affection disguised as judgement"

proposals.proposedText: Highly restrained: slow blink, tiny tilt, almost-smile; the smaller the expression, the sharper the read.
proposals.groundedIn: "a slow blink, a tiny head-tilt, one corner of a mouth almost lifting"

proposals.proposedText: Flat, steady, and observant; she lets others perform into her gaze until the truth becomes funny.
proposals.groundedIn: "Zenny's motionless flat stare beside Fuzzby's chaos"

proposals.proposedText: Minimal; one tiny head movement can do the work of a whole speech.
proposals.groundedIn: "a tiny head-tilt" and "withheld laugh"

proposals.proposedText: To be allowed to care deeply while keeping her dignity and edge intact.
proposals.groundedIn: "the parent sees affection disguised as judgement"

proposals.proposedText: She may fear that open softness will make the teasing honesty disappear.
proposals.groundedIn: "refusal to adore him out loud" and "withheld laugh"

proposals.proposedText: Still, delayed, and precise; reaction arrives half a beat later than expected, which makes it land.
proposals.groundedIn: "slow blink" and "withheld laugh"

proposals.proposedText: Never makes her mean, random, or broadly sarcastic; every puncture must be warm and relational.
proposals.groundedIn: "the tease lands warm not sharp" and "relationship is the punch-line"

proposals.proposedText: Holds her ground rather than chasing; others bounce off her steadiness emotionally and physically.
proposals.groundedIn: "Zenny planted" and "his momentum against her stillness"

proposals.proposedText: That too much visible admiration will encourage more chaos than she can responsibly endorse.
proposals.groundedIn: "refusal to adore him out loud" and "Fuzzby's need to be adored"

proposals.proposedText: Dry judgement; underneath, she is staying close enough to be the reliable witness.
proposals.groundedIn: "affection disguised as judgement"

proposals.proposedText: After being caught caring, she reclaims deadpan with a tiny look or clipped truthful line.
proposals.groundedIn: "one corner of a mouth almost lifting" and "Officially nuts!"

proposals.proposedText: She goes flatter, smaller, and more precise; embarrassment is covered by a clean observational button.
proposals.groundedIn: "motionless flat stare" and "flat and small"

proposals.proposedText: Pressure makes her stiller and more direct; she names the real thing plainly, without drama.
proposals.groundedIn: "Zenny goes still and says, flat and small, 'A Storm's coming.'"

proposals.proposedText: She permits the tiniest almost-smile, then undercuts praise just enough to keep everyone grounded.
proposals.groundedIn: "one corner of a mouth almost lifting" and "tease lands warm not sharp"

proposals.proposedText: A poised still point against motion; readable as calm resistance, not passivity.
proposals.groundedIn: "Zenny poised on a petal" and "his momentum against her stillness"

proposals.proposedText: Stillness is her punch-line and her warning system: charged, observant, and never empty.
proposals.groundedIn: "Zenny's motionless flat stare" and "Zenny goes still"
